data.otel-collector-config.yaml:
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:

processors:
  batch:

exporters:
  otlp:
    endpoint: "$NODE_IP:4317"
    tls:
      insecure: true
  prometheus:
    endpoint: "0.0.0.0:8889"
    namespace: "tgs"

extensions:
  health_check:
    endpoint: 0.0.0.0:13133

service:
  extensions: [health_check]
  pipelines:
    traces: 
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors:
        - batch
      exporters: [otlp]
    metrics:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [prometheus]
